summary: Even more major enhancements to traitor mode

comments.content:
- eliminates "hijack" verb (because there's no legitimate use for it really)
- changes objectives:
    - eliminates "eject engine" objective
    - adds "cut power to 80% of the station" objective (percentage can be
changed easily)
    - adds "kill all monkeys on the station" objective (monkeys are valuable)
    - adds "destroy 70% of plasma containers on the station" objective
(percentage can be changed easily)
    - adds "destroy the AI" objective separate from normal assassination
objective
- changes some text to make more sense
- makes intercept only print on bridge, not in engineering or security
- makes "get rid of everyone" AI objective harder (now you have to get rid
of 75%), better described
- fixes bug that would make it impossible to win with "steal fully charged
laser" objective (it went off of 25 charges rather than the current
maximum, 10)
- generally cleans up code

Can we fix it up so objects in backpacks count towards your stealing goal, or was
that a misinterpreted laser-bug?

I believe that was the laser bug, all items you're carrying or items in items you're
carrying or whatever should work.
